entries.name: GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_PROPERTY_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the GA4 property Brain A reads reports from. Not a secret, and not the G- measurement id.
howToGet: In Google Analytics, open Admin > Property details and copy the Property ID (digits only).

entries.name: GOOGLE_ANALYTICS_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting a Google account with Viewer access to the property, with the analytics.readonly scope only. It uses the same OAuth client as Gmail and Google Workspace but is a separate connection, because each connector stops if its token holds any scope beyond its own. Google doesn't rotate it; the instance keeps a sealed copy in case Google ever returns a new one.
howToGet: Turn on the Google Analytics Data API in the Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client.

Have someone with Viewer access to the property connect to the instance's OAuth client with access_type=offline, prompt=consent and only the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly. Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground with the client's own credentials works (add https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground as an authorized redirect URI).
The connector stops if the token holds anything else, such as analytics (which can change settings), analytics.edit or a Drive or Gmail scope, so don't add them.
Copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
